source: Pew Research Center. 2010. "U.S. Religious Knowledge Survey."
method: Average number correct (out of 32 scored items) per respondent, by present religion (qn20). Correct-answer key transcribed from this dataset's own "Answers to Knowledge Questions" PDF. Don't know/refused (and any other non-matching response) scores as incorrect, matching Pew's own published scoring - not excluded from the item. Groups with fewer than 30 respondents are omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own `weight` variable.
